info.title: Lottery Platform Implemented API
info.description: Current implemented API only. Target 500 betting requests/s is not verified capacity. Withdrawal order/eligibility, commission/reward payout, real payment and external draw API/DOM adapters remain unavailable or stubbed. Browser user sessions use brand-named HttpOnly cookies; bearer tokens are supported for nonbrowser clients. Preserve Host through a trusted reverse proxy; a brand path cannot override a dedicated brand domain. See repository docs/04-api-contract.md and implementation-progress.md for business invariants and accepted scope.

servers.description: Same-origin configured application ingress; host determines user brand.

get.description: Brand-scoped compliance configuration and explicit administrative stub checks only. No live registration/betting/withdrawal gate or real verification. Independent policy version, immutable audited history and decisions, checked encrypted idempotency. Super administrators may read only with explicit platform grants; writes and runs denied. Disabled brands readonly. All-disabled means checks skipped, not a verified user; enabled means review/ADAPTER_NOT_CONFIGURED.

post.description: Global checked mutation independent of a selected brand. X-Brand-ID and query parameters rejected. Explicit platform permission, not super flag or brand grant alone. Code uniqueness, six initial policy/presentation rows, immutable audited creation and encrypted platform idempotency are atomic. Existing configured platform entry permits administration even without an active brand. Replays recheck session/permission and return the same creation snapshot; no automatic scope grants, admins, domains, money or settlement enablement.

post.summary: Add a domain binding to the selected brand
post.description: Requires an explicit brand_domains.write.brand grant for the selected brand or brand_domains.write.platform grant. Super-admin status alone grants no access. The version shares brands.config_version. New domains must be canonical lower-case ASCII dotted DNS names (maximum 253 bytes, labels maximum 63 bytes); URLs, IP addresses, wildcard/local names, localhost, ports, and trailing dots are rejected. A binding cannot take a domain reserved by any brand (including disabled bindings) or the platform; a collision returns 409 BRAND_DOMAIN_CONFLICT. At most 100 bindings per brand, including disabled bindings. A primary domain must be enabled; setting one demotes the previous primary in the same transaction. Legacy localhost/IP bindings may be toggled but never renamed, reassigned, or deleted. No DNS/TLS provisioning or ownership verification is performed. Paused brands remain writable; disabled brands are read-only. Unknown write outcomes must be replayed with the exact frozen key and body; after a 409, reread state and abandon that intent rather than retrying with a new key automatically. Errors: BRAND_DOMAIN_INPUT_INVALID (400), BRAND_DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND (404), PERMISSION_DENIED (403), BRAND_DOMAIN_VERSION_CONFLICT, BRAND_DOMAIN_STATE_CONFLICT, or BRAND_DOMAIN_CONFLICT (409). Successful responses include audit_log_id.

Int64String.description: Exact signed int64 decimal string, within -9223372036854775808..9223372036854775807. Server enforces the numeric bound; the schema checks canonical decimal syntax. Never convert financial values to JavaScript Number.

PositiveInteger.description: Positive JSON integer; server enforces int64 bounds. Numeric versions are not financial amounts.

Reason.description: Nonblank valid UTF-8; limit is 500 bytes, not characters. Leading/trailing spaces are normalized by the applicable handler.

ArbitraryJSON.description: Opaque JSON explicitly accepted/emitted by the relevant domain. This does not imply arbitrary financial writes or configurable rules outside the handler's validation.

allowed_countries.description: Strictly sorted canonical uppercase two-letter tokens; syntax is not a legal jurisdiction approval.

ComplianceConfig.description: All five fields required. Default all flags disabled, age null and countries empty. No live user flow is gated in this configuration/stub stage.

reason.description: Nonempty UTF-8, no surrounding whitespace or control characters; maximum 500 bytes.

ComplianceCheckInput.description: Explicit administrative stub check against current policy version. Rejects personal data, subjects, arbitrary adapter decisions and omitted fields.

ComplianceCheck.description: Current stub returns allow/CHECK_DISABLED if disabled, review/ADAPTER_NOT_CONFIGURED if enabled. deny/freeze reserved, never money/member mutation.

ComplianceDecision.description: Immutable explicit check snapshot, not user verification, review queue, live enforcement, wallet freeze or legal approval. Check order age/region/identity.

svg.description: Inline SVG image for a CAPTCHA challenge; present for CAPTCHA challenges.

nonce.description: One-time OIDC nonce; present for Telegram challenges.

agent_code.description: Empty or whitespace-only values mean not supplied; otherwise the server trims, uppercases, and requires exactly 24 hexadecimal characters.

referral_code.description: Empty or whitespace-only values mean not supplied; otherwise the server trims, uppercases, and requires exactly 24 hexadecimal characters.

IdentityRegisterRequest.description: At least one of username or phone is required. Empty attribution fields mean not supplied; non-empty agent_code and referral_code are mutually exclusive. A supplied code is trimmed, uppercased, and must contain 24 hexadecimal characters. Unknown keys and null values are rejected.

referral_code.description: Empty or whitespace-only values mean not supplied; otherwise the server trims, uppercases, and requires exactly 24 hexadecimal characters.

IdentityLoginRequest.description: Unknown keys and null values are rejected. Empty attribution fields mean not supplied; non-empty codes are mutually exclusive and apply only to a first-time brand join.

IdentityProfileRequest.description: Only previously unset username/phone fields can be supplied; at least one must be non-empty.

agent_code.description: Empty or whitespace-only values mean not supplied; otherwise the server trims, uppercases, and requires exactly 24 hexadecimal characters.

referral_code.description: Empty or whitespace-only values mean not supplied; otherwise the server trims, uppercases, and requires exactly 24 hexadecimal characters.

IdentityTelegramRequest.description: Requires a real Telegram OIDC id_token verified by the server against its configured client ID and this one-time nonce. bind=true requires an existing user session. Empty attribution fields mean not supplied; non-empty codes are mutually exclusive. Telegram login is disabled until configured.

agent_code.description: Accepted by the shared login DTO but ignored by admin authentication.

referral_code.description: Accepted by the shared login DTO but ignored by admin authentication.

AdminLoginRequest.description: Unknown keys and null values are rejected. The additional fields are accepted by the shared LoginInput decoder but ignored by admin authentication.

name.description: Nonempty, no surrounding whitespace or Unicode control characters; maximum 120 UTF-8 bytes.

timezone.description: Valid named IANA timezone or UTC; no empty/Local/surrounding whitespace/control characters.

reason.description: Nonempty, no surrounding whitespace or Unicode control characters; maximum 500 UTF-8 bytes.

AdminBrandCreationInput.description: All five keys are required. Unknown, duplicate and null fields rejected. No input status, brand id, initial money or administrator fields.

AdminBrandCreationReceipt.description: Immutable creation snapshot, not current status/version after subsequent configuration or resume. No auto account/scope/domain/game/fund creation.

AdminMemberUpdateRequest.description: PATCH uses status, notes and reason; password is accepted in the shared request shape but used only by reset-password. Reason is required. Unknown keys are rejected.

AdminMemberKickRequest.description: Only reason is used; the handler's shared closed request DTO also accepts the other listed fields. notes, if supplied, cannot exceed 2000 bytes.

AdminMemberPasswordResetRequest.description: Only password and reason are used; shared handler DTO accepts status and notes. notes, if supplied, cannot exceed 2000 bytes. Reset requires password_reset permission for every brand the global identity belongs to.

AdminRoleCreateRequest.description: status defaults to active; version is ignored at creation. Only brand-scoped permissions can be assigned.

AdminRoleUpdateRequest.description: code cannot be changed and must be omitted or empty. permissions may be empty; only brand-scoped registered permissions are accepted.

AdminAccountCreateRequest.description: Creates a normal, active, non-super-admin account scoped to the selected brand.

AdminAccountUpdateRequest.description: The username is immutable. Updating an account revokes its active sessions; self-edit and super-admin targets are denied.

AdminAccountPasswordResetRequest.description: Resets password and revokes all target admin sessions. Super-admin targets are denied.

agent_code.description: Empty or whitespace-only values mean not supplied; otherwise the server trims, uppercases, and requires exactly 24 hexadecimal characters.

referral_code.description: Empty or whitespace-only values mean not supplied; otherwise the server trims, uppercases, and requires exactly 24 hexadecimal characters.

AdminOperatorCreateRequest.description: At least one of username or phone is required. Creates a new global identity and pending-consent member; it does not reuse existing identities or create a session. Empty attribution fields mean not supplied; non-empty codes are mutually exclusive.

AdminAuthSettingsRequest.description: Client ID is an empty string when disabled or a positive safe-integer decimal string without leading zeroes. Enabling Telegram requires a configured client ID.

domain.description: Canonical lower-case ASCII dotted DNS hostname. New values cannot be URLs, IP addresses, wildcard or local names, localhost, or include a port or trailing dot; each label is at most 63 bytes and the hostname at most 253 bytes.

before_domains.description: Audited pre-change snapshot, sorted by domain then id.

domains.description: Audited post-change snapshot, sorted by domain then id; there may be zero or one primary domain.

anyOf.description: Maximum 2000 UTF-8 bytes; rendered as plain text, never as markup.
